title: Parametric magnetic saw guide
description: A magnetic guide for dovetail and square cuts. Rotate the model, inspect its edges, and slice through the magnet pockets.
notes: Shown here: a 1:5 dovetail slope, five magnet pockets on each side, a 35 mm base width, and 35 mm reach and rise. The pockets are sized for 7.9375 mm × 1.984375 mm disc magnets, with 0.2 mm diameter clearance and 1 mm extra depth. Download the OpenSCAD source to change the slope, magnet layout, dimensions, or fit; it also supports square guides.

attribution.text: Inspired by WordsFail’s 6:1 Small Dovetail Guide (reference license: CC-BY-NC-SA, as recorded in the original CAD source). This parametric implementation includes no reference mesh or artwork.
